scope: Whole archived guide and pinned HTML; source interpretation, not human/server verification

1.original_instruction: Enter the inn in Alberta near (61, 233), then go into the room on the right.
1.short_ru: Войдите в гостиницу Alberta (61, 233) и в комнату справа.
1.short_en: Enter the Alberta inn at (61, 233), then the room on the right.
1.full_ru: Войдите в гостиницу в Alberta около (61, 233), затем зайдите в комнату справа.
1.full_en: Enter the inn in Alberta near (61, 233), then go into the room on the right.

2.original_instruction: Talk with ‘Turtle Grampa’ and choose “How can I get there?”. You can now travel to Turtle Island by talking to the sailor in Alberta located at (247, 122). Each trip costs 10,000 zeny .
2.short_ru: Выберите у Turtle Grampa «How can I get there?»; моряк в Alberta (247, 122) возит на Turtle Island за 10,000 zeny.
2.short_en: Choose “How can I get there?” with Turtle Grampa; the sailor in Alberta (247, 122) travels to Turtle Island for 10,000 zeny.
2.full_ru: Поговорите с ‘Turtle Grampa’ и выберите «How can I get there?». После этого можно отправиться на Turtle Island, поговорив с моряком в Alberta (247, 122). Каждая поездка стоит 10,000 zeny.
2.full_en: Talk with ‘Turtle Grampa’ and choose “How can I get there?”. You can now travel to Turtle Island by talking to the sailor in Alberta located at (247, 122). Each trip costs 10,000 zeny .

requirements.condition: Per journey, not a quest reward or one-time unlock charge.

actions.condition: 10,000 zeny per journey via the sailor.

rewards.condition: Paid travel to Turtle Island unlocked.
